verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents a full developer platform: Python/JS SDKs, a REST API with two auth methods (API key and OAuth), webhooks, and support for building/hosting custom MCP servers (Hosted MCPs) with GitHub-based deploy pipelines, plus proxied MCP support for external servers. This clearly satisfies building custom connectors/private integrations via a documented developer platform. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s) and independent/third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
